title: From epigenetic mark detection to rational design of epigenetic editing strategies.
authors: Faiq, Ali; Haider, Sibtain; Mussolino, Claudio
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦表观遗传标记检测与可编程表观编辑策略，涉及DNA结合平台（如dCas9/TALE）与效应域，但核心是表观修饰而非TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以综述为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟建模深度，仅部分可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Although cells within an organism share nearly identical genomes, their transcriptional programs differ markedly due to reversible chemical modifications known as epigenetic marks. These marks, including DNA methylation and histone modifications, regulate gene expression without altering DNA sequence and play a central role in development and disease. While epigenetic drugs such as DNA methyltransferase inhibitors have shown clinical benefit, their genome-wide activity often results in off-target toxicity limiting broader therapeutic applications. This has driven the development of locus-specific epigenetic editing strategies. Programmable epigenetic modifiers (PEMs) combine customizable DNA-binding platforms, such as CRISPR-dCas systems, transcription activator-like effectors (TALEs), or zinc fingers, with epigenetic effector domains to precisely install or remove regulatory marks at defined genomic loci. Because effective editing depends on the pre-existing epigenetic landscape, detection and characterization of target-site epigenetic states is a prerequisite for rational editor design, increasingly aided by machine-learning models that predict editing outcomes. In this review, we summarize current technologies for epigenetic mark detection and discuss the transition from global pharmacological approaches to programmable, modular editing systems that enable spatial and temporal control of gene regulation. We further address heritability and delivery constraints. Reversible, site-specific epigenetic editing represents a promising therapeutic paradigm for cancer, genetic disorders, and regenerative medicine.
abstract_zh: 尽管生物体内的细胞拥有几乎相同的基因组，其转录程序却因被称为表观遗传标记（epigenetic marks）的可逆化学修饰而显著不同。这些标记，包括DNA甲基化和组蛋白修饰，在不改变DNA序列的情况下调控基因表达，并在发育和疾病中发挥核心作用。尽管诸如DNA甲基转移酶抑制剂等表观遗传药物已显示出临床疗效，其全基因组活性常导致脱靶毒性，限制了更广泛的治疗应用。这推动了位点特异性表观遗传编辑策略的发展。可编程表观遗传修饰因子（PEMs）将可定制的DNA结合平台，如CRISPR-dCas系统、转录激活因子样效应物（TALEs）或锌指，与表观遗传效应结构域相结合，以在特定基因组位点精确安装或移除调控标记。由于有效编辑依赖于预先存在的表观遗传景观，检测和表征靶位点的表观遗传状态是合理设计编辑器的前提，这一过程日益借助预测编辑结果的机器学习模型。在本综述中，我们总结了当前表观遗传标记检测技术，并讨论了从全局药理学方法向可编程、模块化编辑系统的转变，这些系统能够实现基因调控的空间和时间控制。我们进一步探讨了遗传性和递送限制。可逆、位点特异性的表观遗传编辑代表了癌症、遗传疾病和再生医学中一种有前景的治疗范式。
